desc: Implement input parsing (fast stdin) for N, array A, and Q queries.
Compute g[i] for each i (1-indexed): smallest index with A[g[i]] >= 2*A[i], using bisect_left; set g[i] = N+1 if none; define w[i] = g[i] - i.
Build a sparse table for O(1) range-max queries over w[1..N].
For each query (L,R): m = R-L+1; binary search largest K in [0, m//2] such that rangeMax(w, L, L+K-1) <= R-K+1-L (K=0 trivially true).
Verify correctness on the provided samples mentally, including edge cases (K=0, duplicates, g[i]=N+1).
Write final Python solution with fast I/O, O((N+Q) log N) total, printing one answer per line.
